sources.title: OpenTARS/openTARS · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: openTARS A local AI assistant for Linux, Windows and macOS. Ask in your own words and it opens programs, clicks buttons by name, types, searches the web, looks at the screen and runs commands. With a local model, processing stays on your machine. No subscription. This repository is a mirror of the app for people who find openTARS here.
